greeting.subtitle: Your salon at a glance for {{date}}

kpi.emptyRevenue: Shows after your first completed appointment

setup.title: Effortless AI setup
setup.body: Upload photos or screenshots of your current price list and GuGu builds your service menu for you to review and confirm.
setup.privacy: Price list only, no customer details are sent.
setup.importBody: Drop images here or pick from your device: a photo of the price board, a menu, a Facebook/Zalo post or an Excel sheet. Up to 10 images.
setup.importPending: AI import opens here as soon as it is enabled for your salon. Meanwhile you can add services manually.
setup.manualTitle: Or add services one by one
setup.manualBody: Service name, duration and price. You can add options (e.g. short or long hair) and add-ons.

timeline.title: Today's timeline
timeline.subtitle: By team member
timeline.emptyBody: When clients book or you add an appointment, each team member's day shows up here.

activity.title: Latest activity
activity.empty: Your salon's activity will show up here.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.emptyBody: Add services and working hours to start taking bookings. Day, week and per-team-member views appear here.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.emptyBody: Bookings from GuGu, phone calls, Zalo and walk-ins all land here.

customers.title: Customers
customers.emptyBody: Customers are added automatically when they book. Each one gets a visit history, internal notes and tags.

team.title: Team
team.emptyBody: Add team members to set their working hours and assign services.

resources.title: Resources
resources.emptyBody: Add rooms, chairs or beds if some services need their own. Optional.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.emptyBody: Clients can review after a completed appointment. You can reply to each review here.

insights.title: Insights & reports
insights.emptyBody: Appointments, new customers, no-show rate and estimated revenue appear after your first appointments.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceBody: Applies to the salon workspace only.

newAppointment.title: Before you create an appointment
newAppointment.body: You need at least one service and working hours so GuGu can check free times and prevent double bookings.

guard.pendingBody: Open the link in your email to confirm and enter your salon workspace.
guard.noSalonTitle: You don't have a salon on GuGu yet
guard.noSalonBody: Register your salon in a few minutes, or open the invitation link from the salon owner to join their team.

errors.catalog_unknown_staff: Some team members don't belong to this salon.

errors.team_invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation is for another email. Sign in with the invited email.
errors.team_already_member: You're already a member of this salon.
errors.team_seat_limit_reached: Your plan's staff accounts are all in use.

errors.settings_go_live_incomplete: Some setup steps aren't done yet.
errors.salon_unknown_location: The ward isn't in the selected province.

errors.common_rate_limited: Too many attempts, please try again in a few minutes.

errors.entitlement_quota_exceeded: This month's AI allowance is used up.
errors.entitlement_required: Your plan does not include this feature.

services.subtitle: Services, options, add-ons and who performs them
services.emptyBody: Add your first service so clients can book. A combo can be its own service or an add-on.
services.priceMaxHint: If the price depends on the request.
services.bufferAfterHint: Cleanup and preparation for the next client.
services.variantsHint: E.g. short or long hair; hands or feet. Each option has its own price and duration.
services.addOnsHint: Extras clients can add when booking, done in the same appointment.
services.noStaffYet: No team members yet. Add them under Team.

team.subtitle: Team members, roles, working hours and invitations
team.scheduleInvalid: Invalid times: start must be before end, and the break inside working hours.
team.name: Display name
team.bookableHint: Clients and reception can book with this person.
team.noServicesYet: No services yet. Add them under Services.
team.linkEmailed: The invitation was emailed. You can also send this link via Zalo.
team.linkReady: Send this link to your team member via Zalo or chat.

roleHints.staff: Sees their own working hours and appointments.
roleHints.receptionist: Manages the salon's appointments and clients.
roleHints.manager: Manages services, team and settings (not plan billing).

team.inviteEmailHint: If set, only this email can use the invitation and GuGu emails it.
team.addMeTitle: Do you also perform services yourself?
team.addMeBody: Add yourself to the team to take bookings with your own working hours.

settings.hoursInvalid: Opening time must be before closing time.
settings.confirmAutoHint: Bookings are confirmed as soon as the client books.
settings.confirmManualHint: The salon confirms within {{hours}} hours; after that the booking is cancelled and the client is told.
settings.confirmNewClientsHint: Bookings from first-time or unverified clients wait for salon confirmation.
settings.hideStaffChoiceHint: Clients book without choosing a team member; the salon assigns one.
settings.leadTimeHint: Clients can't book closer to the start than this.
settings.bookingWindowHint: How far ahead clients can book.
settings.cancelCutoffHint: After this, clients contact the salon to cancel or reschedule.
settings.cancellationPolicyHint: Shown to clients when they book.

join.invalidTitle: This invitation is invalid or has expired
join.invalidBody: Ask the salon owner to send you a new invitation link.
join.title: Join {{salon}}
join.emailBound: This invitation is for a specific email. Sign in with that email.

aiImport.pickHint: Photos of your price board or menu, or Facebook/Zalo screenshots. Up to {{max}} images.
aiImport.privacyBody: Before AI reads your images, GuGu's server blacks out phone numbers, emails, links, people's names and faces. Images are not stored.
aiImport.reading: Removing private details and reading your price list…
aiImport.notConfigured: AI import is not enabled on this server. You can add services manually.
aiImport.notEntitled: Your plan does not include AI import.
aiImport.reviewBody: Services found: {{count}}. Fix names, prices or durations if needed and untick rows you don't want.
aiImport.redactedNote: Private areas blacked out before sending: {{count}}.
aiImport.empty: No services could be read. Try a sharper photo, taken straight on in good light.
aiImport.invalidRows: Rows missing a name, price or duration: {{count}}.
aiImport.done: Services added: {{count}}. You can edit them in the list below.
aiImport.pickFailed: Could not open your photo library.
